shortDesc: One notification (from ListNotifications notifications[]): who replied to your post or comment, the post title, an excerpt and the age; unread ones carry an orange dot. Links to the comment on the post. Stack several for /notifications.

props.name: notification
props.description: { type: 'post-reply' | 'comment-reply', postId, postTitle, commentId, fromName, excerpt, createdAt, read }.

styling.tailwindClasses: grid grid-cols-[10px_1fr_auto] gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-white px-3 py-2
styling.notes: Orange unread dot; grey excerpt; relative time on the right.
